name: SpeakApp
description: Connect Claude to everything you've captured in SpeakApp — meetings, voice notes, lectures. Ask what was said, pull summaries and action items, and bring that context into your work or code.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SpeakApp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SpeakApp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.speakapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SpeakApp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SpeakApp provides these MCP tools: get_recording and list_recordings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SpeakApp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SpeakApp in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SpeakApp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SpeakApp is developed by SpeakApp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
